question: Calcium sulphate dihydrate is the chemical name of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**gypsum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gypsum** is the chemical name for **calcium sulphate dihydrate**.
 
• It is a naturally occurring mineral used in various industries such as **construction, agriculture, and food production**.
 
• In construction, gypsum is used to make **plaster, drywall**, and other **building materials **due to its **fire-resistant properties**.
 
• In agriculture, gypsum is used to improve soil structure and reduce soil compaction, enhancing water infiltration and root growth.
 
• In the food industry, gypsum is used as a coagulant in products like tofu and as a calcium supplement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Washing soda** is sodium carbonate (**Na₂CO₃**) and is used in laundry detergents and cleaning agents.
 
• **Baking powder** is a mixture of baking soda (**sodium bicarbonate**) and an acid, used as a leavening agent in baking.
 
• **Plaster of Paris** is a quick-setting gypsum plaster consisting of a fine white powder (**calcium sulfate hemihydrate**) that hardens when moistened and allowed to dry.
 
• Gypsum is a versatile material with a wide range of applications, making it an important mineral in various sectors.
